title: Convexity conjecture for the Gamma-type non-negativity domains
statement:
For positive real numbers $a$ and $b$, let ${\mathcal{D}}_{a,b}$ denote the parameter set introduced in the paper for the corresponding Gamma-type non-negativity problem.

**Convexity conjecture.** For every $a,b>0$, the set ${\mathcal{D}}_{a,b}$ is convex.

This is posed as a natural open problem arising from the probabilistic reformulation of non-negativity questions for hypergeometric functions and Bessel functions of the first kind; no resolution is given here.
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1908.03428

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of August 2019).
source_name: Tetyana Kadankova, Thomas Simon and Min Wang, “On some new moments of Gamma type”, arXiv:1908.03428 (2023).
